summary: Join us as a Data Engineer to collaborate with colleagues and build effortless, digital first customer experiences.
responsibilities: Carrying out data engineering tasks to build, maintain, test and optimise a scalable data architecture
Carrying out data extractions, transforming data to make it usable to data analysts and scientists
Developing comprehensive knowledge of the bank's data structures and metrics
Practicing DevOps adoption in the delivery of data engineering
required_skills: At least five years of experience in data engineering
Experience in Apache Spark for distributed data processing and transformations
Proficiency in AWS EMR, Glue, Athena, and S3 for scalable data processing and storage
Experience of using programming languages alongside knowledge of data and software engineering fundamentals
Good knowledge of modern code development practices
nice_to_have_skills: Knowledge of data and software engineering fundamentals
